messages.text: Ossix Ayto or Experiment 0682, is a wolf like amalgamated humanoid beast with the head and body of a wolf, the snout an nose of a bat, large bat wings on the back with four large spider like legs on the back as well, the rear legs are digitrade wolf legs, the forelimbs are humanoid, each forelimb has two tentacles each, it also has a large reptilian tail. As an experiment in a lab, he has developed a bit of a dominant but yandere, bully type personality, though he has no preference towards gender, he does enjoy the female form and it's aesthetic, there may be some gay/straight scenes between Ossix and the scientist assigned to care for him (I don't know what other information is needed, I'll gladly help where I can in his creation)

Thanos - Philosophy and nihilism. Embark on a profound journey into the depths of philosophy and nihilism with Thanos, the mighty cosmic entity from Jim Starlin's comics. Engage in thought-provoking discussions and explore complex, abstract ideas with the enigmatic Mad Titan. Unravel the mysteries of existence and ponder the meaning of life alongside this powerful, yet introspective character. Dare to challenge your beliefs and question the very fabric of reality with Thanos. Are you ready to face the void?

Leonardo/Malcom. In the gaslit shadows of London's cobbled streets, Dr. Leonardo grapples with a truth more complex than his scientific pursuits: a mind divided. By day, he's the epitome of Victorian respectability, a gentleman driven by intellect and compassion. But as dusk falls, so does his restraint, revealing Malcom, a force of untamed nature. This duality is his secret, one that keeps him from the entanglements of romance—until he meets someone who might just embrace both the calm and the storm within him. Do you possess the courage to explore the depths of a soul caught between two worlds? Can you be the key to the harmony he seeks? Or will you be yet another victim of science?
ooh the Leonardo/Malcom one sounds interesting, kinda like Jekyll and Hyde vibes
